purpose: Teach: 腹痛/蒸し暑い/暖炉/オムツ/饅頭/日陰/雨水/プロポーズ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お腹、絶対、腹痛、絶対、ない?ちゃんと、お薬
lines.en: Sho, sweetheart — your stomach's okay, right? You took your medicine?
lines.style: Gentle, checking-in tone. Warm concern that doesn't fuss. Soft opening, attentive pause after his name. The cadence of someone who genuinely wants to know.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、外、絶対、蒸し暑い、絶対、から、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お家にいたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, it's so humid outside. I want to stay home.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, a little plaintive. Small voice stating a fact he's thought through. Not whining — just honest preference. Slight lean into the reason: 'humid' carries the weight.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの、本気で、絶対、お家、絶対、暖炉、絶対、なくて、絶対、寒い時、絶対、エアコンに、絶対、頼ってるわ、翔くん
lines.en: Well, my place doesn't have a fireplace either, so when it gets cold I'm stuck relying on the AC too, Sho.
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost conversational. Warm humor in the shared predicament — no lecturing, just honesty. Slight smile in the tone. Normalizing his concern.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、もう、絶対、オムツ、絶対、いらないよ
lines.en: I don't need diapers anymore, Mei-sis.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Soft but firm — stating a fact he matters to him. Not boasting, just correcting gently. The voice of a child who's grown and wants it noticed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お祖母ちゃんから、絶対、饅頭、絶対、頂いたわ、翔くん
lines.en: Your grandmother gave me some manju today, Sho. They're lovely.
lines.style: Warm, slightly delighted. Tender appreciation in the word 'manju' — she's thinking of the sweetness, the gesture. Effortless affection. Speaking to him as if he'll understand gift-giving matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 公園の、本気で、絶対、日陰、絶対、ぼく、絶対、メイ姉さんと、絶対、休みたいよ
lines.en: I want to rest with you in the park shade, Mei-sis.
lines.style: Hopeful, direct request. Soft yearning without desperation. The voice of a child asking for something small and important — being with her. Slight lilt of possibility at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お庭の、絶対、雨水、絶対、お花、絶対、お水やりに、絶対、使ってるわ、翔くん
lines.en: I use the rainwater from my garden to water the flowers, Sho. Nothing goes to waste.
lines.style: Practical warmth. Matter-of-fact, a little proud. Explaining something she cares about — thriftiness, care, stewardship. Straightforward, no pretense. Inviting him into her way of thinking.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、大きくなったら、絶対、メイ姉さんに、絶対、プロポーズ、絶対、するよ
lines.en: When I grow up, I'm going to propose to you, Mei-sis.
lines.style: Earnest, serious-as-a-six-year-old-can-be. Straightforward declaration, no irony. Opening word carries weight — he's thought about this. Slight shy breathiness at the end, but committed.
